exactCurrentRulesFacts.pearlMultiplierIncrementRule: Pearls on reels 1 and 2 without a winning Pearl combination increase multiplier by 1x
exactCurrentRulesFacts.pearlMultiplierResetRule: resets to 1x when Pearl symbols create a winning combination, except during Mermaid Bonus

structuralEdgeHypothesis.description: Because the Pearl Multiplier is explicitly invariant to bet changes while Pearl cash/jackpot awards scale with current bet, a multiplier state accumulated while wagering at a lower stake may have greater monetary option value after switching to a higher stake.
structuralEdgeHypothesis.whyNotYet: The exact transition probabilities into multiplier increments, Pearl wins/resets and Mermaid Bonus, plus the cost/return distribution while building state, are not published in the recovered exact rules.

exactPayoutScalingExamplesNotEvClaims.note: These follow directly from exact X-bet jackpot factors and the current Pearl Multiplier; they are contingent payout values, not probabilities or expected values.

conservativeJackpotEventThresholds.model: For a single high-stake exercise spin, ignoring every ordinary return and every non-jackpot Pearl/cash value, if p is the probability that the spin yields a winning Pearl combination containing at least a given jackpot tier, lower-bound net EV is -S + p*tierX*M*S. Break-even p=1/(tierX*M).
conservativeJackpotEventThresholds.guard: No such jackpot-event probability has been verified for the current served game; these are algebraic thresholds only.

priority.reason: Unlike ordinary per-bet persistence, exact Spanish rules explicitly preserve the Pearl Multiplier across bet changes while its payouts scale with the current bet. This creates genuine cross-bet monetary leverage, but transition probabilities and build economics remain unresolved.
